verdict.rationale: Apple's own docs give only a general claim that M4 Max handles demanding pro workloads with high energy efficiency and long laptop battery life. That touches performance per watt but says nothing about sustained, throttle-free behavior over long renders. Community items cover burst Geekbench scores and process-node advantages, not sustained or thermal testing. missing for 10: documented power/thermal envelopes (TDP or watts under load), sustained-load or throttling data for long renders and exports, independent perf-per-watt testing, measured battery life under heavy workloads.

support.subject: As a creator, long renders and exports don't throttle away — documented power envelopes and independent testing showing strong sustained performance per watt

citations.quote: M4 Max rips through the most challenging pro workloads and, thanks to the energy efficiency of Apple silicon, delivers exceptional battery life in a laptop.
